mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance( employee_id, title, work_item, start_date, expected_end_date, work_detail, status, achievement_rate, difficulty_score, comment, feedback, created_at ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{title}, #{workItem, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{startDate}, #{expectedEndDate}, #{workDetail}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{achievementRate}, #{difficultyScore}, #{comment}, #{feedback}, NOW() )
